findings.message: The param listaId selects formularioLista but no request fetches one lista; added public selectLista(id | null) and the getter formularioLista (row of the loaded listas), which also fills salvarListaDraft; an unresolved id publishes client.selectionInvalid in listarListasError.
buscarListas takes a name fragment but no state holds it; added the state busca (transient, '' on entry) written by buscarListas(busca).

The commands criarLista and salvarLista have no <command>.input state; added criarListaDraft and salvarListaDraft with setCriarListaDraft and setSalvarListaDraft. The empty draft leaves ativa null, so the page must set it before submitting.

criarLista/salvarLista return the lista and it is upserted by id in listas, but the shared cannot sort by name or re-apply the active busca filter, so a new row is appended at the end and may not match the current search; pageStatus stays 'empty' after the first lista is created from an empty page (only the load writes it). Reloading would fix it but the route does not say so.
The output lista of criarLista and salvarLista has no state as source; it is applied to listas (upsert by id) and, for salvarLista, to salvarListaDraft.
public busca is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
